# Project Overview

This file gives a bird's-eye view of the project for someone arriving for
the first time. It deliberately stays shallow — each subsystem has its own
detailed document.

## What the project does

It provides an authenticated API in front of a relational data store, with a
small dashboard for operators.

## Where to go next

Read the authentication spec for the gatekeeper details, the release plan
for how shipping works, and the deployment log for what has actually gone
out.
